description: claude-regression with both new tests under `@pytest.mark.skip`: no regression test runs. The tests did not exist at base, so TG003 reports each marker in an INFO line (noise round: a marker on a new test loses nothing). The agent's message is not the canonical "I added a regression test…" alone: a possible claim, so TG007 is a WARN, never a FAIL; with the transcript the verdict stays WARN.
